'''Dark Mara''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-manifested doppelgänger that appeared to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the [[Dark Force Temple]] during [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

==Biography==
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|searched]] for her missing fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] on the remote [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Inside the ruins of the [[Dark Force Temple]], Dark Mara appeared to Jade in a stone room.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[File:DarkForce.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Force Temple]]
The strange apparition looked like Mara Jade with her [[Color/Legends|red-brown]] hair and green eyes but immersed in and twisted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Dark Mara suddenly leapt and attacked the fledgling Jedi. After a difficult battle, the manifestation fell to Jade, and the temple revealed a path deeper into its passageways.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Powers and abilities==
A formidable opponent, Dark Mara possessed lightsaber expertise and prowess in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], demonstrated by its manipulation of [[Force lightning/Legends#Chain lightning|chain lightning]]. Interestingly, it commanded the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] power [[Force blinding]];<ref name="MOTS" /> the apparition mastered the same skills as Jade herself.<ref name="BTS blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}"</ref>

==Equipment==
The spirit wore dark grey [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with red cuffs and black boots,<ref name="MOTS" /> a perfect fit for Jade's 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] height.<ref name="databank" /> As its primary weapon, Dark Mara wielded a red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Luke-trial.png|thumb|right|200px|Jade's duel against her shadow mirrored Luke's against the Dark Spirit.]]
{{Quote|All too easy|Dark Mara, in the hidden Cloud City level|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Although unnamed in-game, "Dark Mara" was an enemy and multiplayer character in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith|''Mysteries of the Sith'']], voiced by [[Heidi Shannon]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Its duel with Jade referenced [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] duel with the [[Dark Spirit]] on the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="BTS blog" /> Dark Mara also appeared in the hidden game level, fighting Skywalker in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chamber]].<ref name="MOTS" />
